articles.summary: IP CTS calling grew from 2.4M minutes in 2009 to 511.6M in 2019 (FCC). How captioning glasses caption phone and video calls hands-free — a modern alternative to TTY and captioned telephones.
articles.title: Captioning Glasses on Phone and Video Calls: A Hands-Free Alternative to TTY and Captioned Telephones

articles.summary: 82% of deaf patients report not understanding their diagnosis after a visit (PMC, 2019). How captioning glasses close the exam-room communication gap — and what the ADA already requires.
articles.title: Captioning Glasses for Doctor Visits: What HoH Patients Wish Their Provider Knew

articles.summary: Skilled lipreaders average just 50.7% of words from lips alone (PMC, 2023). Here's why pairing lipreading with in-view captions — one field of view, eyes on the face — beats either channel by itself.
articles.title: Lipreading Plus Captions: Why Combining Both Beats Either Alone

articles.summary: 14.4% of adults worldwide live with tinnitus (JAMA Neurology, 2022). Why captioning glasses that cut listening effort can lower tinnitus distress when straining to hear makes the ringing louder.
articles.title: Captioning Glasses for Tinnitus: Why Reducing Listening Effort Quiets the Ringing

articles.summary: Concerts hit 94-110 dBA (NIDCD, 2024), loud enough to bury lyrics and every word your friends say. How captioning glasses put the words back in your field of view in real time.
articles.title: Captioning Glasses at Concerts and Live Music: Reading Lyrics and Crowd Conversations in Real Time

articles.summary: 55% of adults over 75 have disabling hearing loss (NIDCD, 2024), and worship spaces are the hardest rooms to hear in. How captioning glasses restore the sermon, the prayers, and the hymns.
articles.title: Captioning Glasses in Places of Worship: Hearing Sermons, Prayers, and Hymns Again

articles.summary: Roughly 60,000 US adults develop single-sided deafness each year (Laryngoscope, 2022). Why captioning smart glasses often outperform CROS hearing aids in restaurants, meetings, and group settings.
articles.title: Single-Sided Deafness (SSD): Why Captioning Glasses Beat CROS Hearing Aids for Many Users
